name: Ogasawara Islands
description: The Ogasawara Islands are a chain of more than 30 subtropical islands in the Pacific, about 1,000 km south-southeast of Tokyo. Their long isolation has earned them the nickname "Galápagos of the Orient," with unique plants, birds and the critically endangered Bonin flying fox. Only two islands have permanent residents, and the surrounding waters shelter whales, fish and corals.
